requiredBeforeFirstSeriousCandidate: missing visible components registered as reusable Layer A assets
reference crop -> scope mask -> context separation -> PNG integrity -> 2D reassembly -> shallow 2.5D
persistent roots, visible-art bounds, anchors, component IDs, side/back treatment
responsive openings, wall panels, trim, foundation, and landing contracts
helper geometry excluded from beauty renders
Codex inspection of the actual Blender render
regressionChecks: window visible size and four-corner trim continuity
organic asset complete silhouette and side depth
contextMaskRequirement: Codex creates clean component masks autonomously; context contamination must be zero or explicitly vision-approved before first serious candidate
heroModuleExtentReview: required front and side extent review for fascia, awning, and organic modules
upperTransitionDecomposition: upper architectural transitions must be visually decomposed from the reference before first-pass assembly
wallContinuity: modular wall pieces preserve cross-panel tonal continuity
organicSideVisionGate: organic modules require side-depth vision review before operator review
shellSurfaceDecomposition: visible shell surface detail, cornices, transition trims, contact shadows, and cross-panel continuity are mandatory in initial reference decomposition
observedPixelsPrinciple: OBSERVED PIXELS ARE CONSTRAINTS. HIDDEN GEOMETRY IS INFERENCE.
organicPresentationDerivativePolicy: For small organic GrowGo assets where full 3D reconstruction provides poor cost/benefit, a deterministic multi-view presentation derivative is allowed when editable modular source is preserved, the reference-facing view is faithful, all required gameplay views are approved, identity remains consistent, and runtime budget passes.

architecturalReconstructionRule.moldingDepth: measured cross-sections and parallel face bands
architecturalReconstructionRule.prohibition: Do not turn shadows, antialiasing, or perspective pixels into physical geometry for simple rectilinear building components.
